name: Woodsmith of hilton head island
old_description: Our dining room table had a glass top and two columns that screamed “1990’s”. Because we had a custom-made area rug that we did not want to replace, we struggled with how to update the dining room set. We were so excited when we found Brian online. He was amazing to work with and the new pedestals matched our existing chairs perfectly. We are so pleased!
about:
Woodsmith of Hilton Head Island operates from Hilton Head Island, South Carolina, where founder Brian Meehan designs and builds custom furniture as a solo woodworker. The business began from Meehan's passion for crafting furniture and smaller items from wood, though a founding year is not publicly stated.

The shop produces one-of-a-kind pieces including dining tables, benches, live-edge countertops, shelves, and specialty items such as shot-glass displays. Each project is custom designed and hand crafted from start to finish using hand-picked furniture-grade lumber, with Meehan working on only one client's project at a time. The workshop has no showroom; clients collaborate directly on design before fabrication begins.

The clientele is primarily residential—homeowners and rental-property owners seeking bespoke furniture for dining rooms, bourbon rooms, and custom millwork. Testimonials reference projects for private homes and a rental house on Hilton Head Island.

Meehan emphasizes that quality craftsmanship requires time and diligence, noting that the project queue can extend several months because each piece receives his full attention. The model is built on shared vision with the customer rather than volume production.
